hook: Linq Buslines managers were fined $7,000 after 10 lives were lost.

sections.voiceover: Linq Buslines managers were fined $7,000 after 10 lives were lost.
b_roll: graphic display showing $7,000 fine and 10 lives lost statistic

sections.voiceover: In June 2023, a Hunter Valley crash injured 25 people. Rodney Parker, age 42, entered a guilty plea in court. Why did hiring with a texted reference risk a $59,000 fine?
b_roll: map animation of Hunter Valley showing 25 people injured
graphic card displaying Rodney Parker age 42 court filing
diagram of texted reference check leading to $59,000 maximum penalty

sections.voiceover: However, Katie Parker, age 39, also faced a maximum fine of $59,000 before pleading guilty.
b_roll: graphic card displaying Katie Parker age 39 with $59,000 fine counter

sections.voiceover: On November 23, 2026, Gosford Local Court issued the sentences. Careless driver recruitment directly caused the crash with 10 fatalities. Judges ordered Rodney Parker and Katie Parker to pay $7,000 each.
b_roll: timeline card showing November 23 2026 at Gosford Local Court
flow diagram linking driver recruitment to 10 fatalities
split graphic showing $7,000 individual fines for both managers

sections.voiceover: The crash left 25 people injured in Hunter Valley.
b_roll: map display of Hunter Valley highlighting 25 people injured
